'''CT-66-3232''' was a clone trooper cadet who served in the [[Bravo Squad (clone cadets)/Legends|Bravo Squad]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This Bravo Squad cadet's identification number was first depicted in the picture to the left. It says 66-3232, and the prefix CT- was predetermined. This way of determining identification numbers was proved with the troopers in Domino Squad.
